pressure_note: not stated (presumably ambient; no pressure given in the paper)

composition.other_species: salt named in label row (set via composition.salt): MgCl2, CaCl2, Na2SO4 are in scope; SrCl2, BaCl2, LaCl3, NaNO3, NaBr, KNO3, KBr, Cd(NO3)2 are outside the six-ion set and kept as printed

conversion_needs: molality as printed is taken as mol per kg of water (text: 'Solutions were on the molal basis'); no solution densities needed
notes: Printed wide (nine temperature columns 15-55 C, step 5 C). Restructured to long form: one label row per salt, then rows of (m, T, value) for each temperature column. Temperature columns that are blank for the whole salt block (40 and 50 C for most salts) are not written; blanks inside a written column (Na2SO4, KNO3) are written as rows with empty value. Property sub-blocks of the printed Table II (density, viscosity, conductivity) are split into separate tables; conductivity not extracted. Cadmium nitrate viscosity continues on journal page 50. 2026-10-11 coordinator: per_row key renamed salt -> salt_from_label_row so the loader pairs the label-row salt with the molality column (was held as salt 'salt'). Value unit set to mPa_s (printed mN s m-2, identical); printed string kept in unit_as_printed.
title_as_printed: Density rho, Viscosity eta, and Electrolytic Conductivity kappa of Several Aqueous Electrolyte Solutions

value.what: absolute viscosity, Ubbelohde viscometers, relative to pure water (Table I) and secondary standards
